card.name: Digits in years within science pages
card.fires_on: Digits inside four-digit years, especially in parenthesised date ranges such as project spans, and a few words around dates in geography or science text about mountains, polar regions and nature.

modes.label: Year digits
modes.description: A digit partway through a four-digit year, often in a date range or citation.
modes.example: Global Science in the Antarctic Context (2005-20<<0>>9) > Biodiversity, Functions

modes.label: Mountain facts
modes.description: Words around a date or name in text about a famous mountain or plateau.
modes.example: the world’s highest mountain was named in 1865<< after>> Sir George Everest.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed, though the suppressed ones are mostly desert and mountain words.
card.plain: It lights up on digits within years in science and nature writing, such as Antarctic project dates.
